## Service: links (Trigger Links API)

### Create Link
POST /links/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/links/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/links/create-link | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/links/create-link.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: links.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) LinksDto:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID of the business profile
- name* string (e.g. "first tag") - Display name of the trigger link
- redirectTo* string (e.g. "https://www.google.com/") - URL or variable to redirect to when the trigger link is clicked

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- link object - The trigger link object
  - id string - Unique identifier of the trigger link
  - name string - Display name of the trigger link
  - redirectTo string - URL or variable to redirect to when the trigger link is clicked
  - fieldKey string - Template variable key used to reference this trigger link
  - locationId string - Location ID this trigger link belongs to

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
